desc:
You’re stuck in school, and the teachers are after you! Don’t get caught before you escape.

Run across keyboard keys to gain Speed, complete challenging stages, and make your way out of the school.

Earn Wins, unlock Trails and Book Bags, and Rebirth to become even faster. How far can you escape?

How to Play:
👟 Every step makes you faster
🏆 Overcome obstacles to get wins
💪 Unlock new upgrades
🔥 Rebirth to push your limits

If you’re having fun, don't forget to like the game! 👍
